name: Recipe Scaler: Recipe Manager
subtitle: Import, scale & cook with AI
description:
All your recipes in one place: from websites, Telegram, photos and notes. Recipe Scaler picks out the ingredients and steps for you and scales the servings for any number of guests.

SAVE RECIPES FROM ANYWHERE
• Paste a link, and the recipe is saved with its photo, ingredients and steps
• Snap a cookbook page or paste some text, and the ingredients and steps are recognized for you
• Forward a recipe to our Telegram bot, and it lands in your library in a few seconds
• Tap Share in Safari or any other app
• Moving from Paprika or Crouton? Import their files in one go
• Sort recipes into collections: breakfasts, desserts, “want to cook”

SERVINGS THAT SCALE THEMSELVES
A recipe for two and six guests coming? Change the servings, and every amount is recalculated. Nutrition facts can be shown next to the ingredients.

COOK WITHOUT THE STRESS
• Tap a time in a recipe step to start a timer
• Timers show up on the Lock Screen and on Apple Watch
• The screen stays on while you cook, and you can scroll the recipe by voice or gesture when your hands are covered in dough

AI ASSISTANT
Ask in plain words: “What can I use instead of sour cream?”, “Will this dough rise in two hours?”, “What can I make with chicken and rice?” The assistant knows your recipes and can write a new one and save it. Shake your phone to open it.

SHOPPING LIST
Ingredients from several recipes go into one list. Sync it with Reminders or send a link to whoever is going to the store.

SHARE RECIPES
Send a recipe as a link or open a public profile with your collection. In Discover, follow authors and get notified about their new recipes.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and the web app at recipe-scaler.ru. Everything works offline and syncs between devices. Widgets, Spotlight search and Siri shortcuts are built in. And through MCP, your recipes are available in Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants.

Sign up without an email or phone number. No ads.

promotionalText: Now on iPad and Apple Watch: keep a recipe next to the AI assistant on the big screen and check your cooking timers on your wrist.
